title: E0119: Session cookie without Secure flag
plain_english: Session cookies configured without the `Secure` flag can be sent over unencrypted HTTP connections, increasing the risk of interception.
why_matters: Without the `Secure` flag on session cookies: - Session IDs can be exposed through network sniffing - Attackers on the same network may be able to hijack sessions - Authentication is more vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks
what_it_checks: `session_set_cookie_params()` with `secure => false`, or where `secure` is not set
`ini_set('session.cookie_secure', '0')`, or cases where it is not set
Session cookies created without the `Secure` attribute
